title: Cell Culture Transfection and Immunoblotting
author: Roberta Marongiu
materials: Maintain N27 cells in complete DMEM medium
Seed cells to appropriate density prior to transfection.
Quantify protein concentration using a BCA assay .
Lyse cells using the prepared Lysis Buffer (chilled).
Aspirate medium and wash cells with PBS.
Incubate with HRP-coupled secondary antibodies for 1 hour at room temperature .
Incubate with primary antibodies in blocking buffer or TBST overnight at 4 degrees .
Apply Lumigen chemiluminescent reagents to the membrane according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Analyze protein band density using Quantity One software.
Capture images using the VersaDoc MP 4000 system.

steps.title: Maintain cells in incubator
steps.instruction: Incubate the cell culture at 37 °C in a humidified atmosphere with 5 % CO₂ and 95 % air.

steps.title: Transiently transfect with FuGENE6
steps.instruction: Perform a transient DNA transfection of the pAAV plasmid using FuGENE6 reagent, following the Promega manufacturer’s protocol for reagent‑to‑DNA ratios.

substeps.instruction: Prepare the DNA‑FuGENE6 mixture according to Promega‑specified ratios.
Add the mixture to the cells under the incubation conditions described above.

steps.title: Post‑transfection incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the transfected cells for 48 hours.

steps.title: Normalize protein amount
steps.instruction: Prepare lysates and normalize each sample to an equal amount of protein (100 µg per sample).

substeps.instruction: Determine protein concentration of each lysate.
Adjust volume with lysis buffer so that each sample contains exactly 100 µg protein.

steps.title: Clarify lysates
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysates to remove debris and collect the supernatant (whole‑cell lysate).

steps.title: Load and run SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Load 100 µg of protein into each lane of an SDS‑PAGE gel and run electrophoresis at the desired voltage.

substeps.instruction: Load the normalized samples into the gel wells.
Run the gel at the voltage appropriate for the gel size and composition.

steps.title: Transfer proteins to membrane
steps.instruction: Transfer proteins from the gel onto a PVDF membrane.

steps.title: Block membrane
steps.instruction: Block the PVDF membrane with 5 % milk in TBST for 1 hour at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash membrane with TBST
steps.instruction: Wash the blocked membrane with TBST three times for 10 minutes each (and an additional wash if desired).

substeps.instruction: Add TBST to the membrane and incubate 10 min; discard.
Repeat the wash two more times.
Perform an extra TBST wash as indicated.
